label: Adjustment A/P Requests - Control
description: Every adjustment A/P request in a window, grouped by request status and adjustment status, with the action each combination needs: a request the ERP canceled while the adjustment is still open must have its adjustment canceled by a user; a paid request on a canceled adjustment is a refund to recover. The requests behind each combination are listed underneath.
subreport: reports/subreports/adj_ap_requests_detail.jrxml  (a local jrxml resource of the unit named adj_ap_requests_detail; the main says repo:adj_ap_requests_detail)

inputControls.label: A/P request status (blank = all)
inputControls.query: SELECT TRIM(l.field_value) AS CODE, TRIM(l.field_value) || ' - ' || l.descr AS DESCR FROM CISADM.CI_LOOKUP_VAL_L l WHERE TRIM(l.field_name) = 'PYMNT_SEL_STAT_FLG' AND l.language_cd = 'ENG' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CISADM.CI_ADJ_APREQ r JOIN CISADM.CI_ADJ a ON a.adj_id = r.adj_id WHERE TRIM(r.pymnt_sel_stat_flg) = TRIM(l.field_value) AND a.cre_dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3' YEAR) ORDER BY 1

inputControls.label: Adjustment status (blank = all)
inputControls.query: SELECT TRIM(l.field_value) AS CODE, TRIM(l.field_value) || ' - ' || l.descr AS DESCR FROM CISADM.CI_LOOKUP_VAL_L l WHERE TRIM(l.field_name) = 'ADJ_STATUS_FLG' AND l.language_cd = 'ENG' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CISADM.CI_ADJ a JOIN CISADM.CI_ADJ_APREQ r ON r.adj_id = a.adj_id WHERE TRIM(a.adj_status_flg) = TRIM(l.field_value) AND a.cre_dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3' YEAR) ORDER BY 1

inputControls.label: Action needed only (type anything for yes) (blank = all)
